messages:
Alex: quick q — dashboard shows p50/p95/p99 by endpoint and region. noticed for /v2/embed (eu-west) p95 > p99, which smells off. anyone seen this pattern before?
Maya: that shouldn't happen unless samples are coming from different rollups or we mix sampled vs full aggregates. do you have a screenshot? :eyes:
Alex: attaching snippet (copied values): `p50: 48ms, p95: 820ms, p99: 760ms` — pasted from the console panel.
Raj: aha, looks like a merge of two series with different sample sizes. we recently enabled route-level fallback routing which tags some requests as `route:legacy` and others `route:fastpath`. if the panel aggregates both without weighting by sample count you can get anomalies.
Sarah: quick repro idea: open the endpoint breakdown and toggle "include route tags" to see split. if split fixes order then it's an aggregation-weighting issue.
Alex: did that — when split the p99 for fastpath is 720ms and for legacy is 1100ms, but when combined p99 becomes 760 and p95 820. so ordering flips.
Tina: sounds like we're computing percentiles on concatenated rollup percentiles rather than raw samples. iirc our backend stores tdigest per shard and merges; if metadata about sample counts is missing we fall back to naive merge which can invert ranks.
Raj: exact. the merge path uses a lightweight merge when `sample_count` tag is absent in the rollup header. a recent router change dropped that header for routed fallbacks.
Maya: action items: 1) add a dashboard hint that mixed-route aggregation requires sample-aware merge, 2) fix router to preserve sample_count header, 3) add a lint that warns when percentile ordering violates monotonicity for same endpoint/period.
Alex: +1 on all. can we also surface per-route sample counts in the UI next to each series? that makes debugging faster.
Sarah: agree. UX note: show a small badge "n=12k" next to the line and a tooltip explaining merge semantics.
Tina: i'll open a quick PR to restore the header and add a test simulating merged tdigest inversion.
Raj: i'll file a console bug for the UI badges and the lint rule.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: fix/route-sample-count-header -> staging at 2023-11-05T21:00:00Z :rocket:
Alex: thanks all — label as P1 for visibility with oncall if this affects SLO alerts (p99-based). will follow-up post staging test. :thumbsup:
